description: The OD-01 Regional Transport Office serves the Balasore district of Odisha. It is a key administrative hub for vehicle registration, licensing, and road safety enforcement in the northern coastal region of the state.
address: Near ITI Square, Angargadia, Balasore, Odisha

description: OD-02 is the primary Regional Transport Office for Bhubaneswar-I, serving the capital city of Odisha. This office is responsible for vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit administration for the central and southern regions of the metropolitan area.
address: Bhoinagar Basti, Acharya Vihar, Near Maharaja Cinema Hall, Bhoi Nagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha

description: The OD-03 RTO serves the Balangir district in Odisha, overseeing vehicle registration, driver licensing, and motor vehicle tax collection. It transitioned from the OR-03 prefix in 2012 following the official change of the state's name from Orissa to Odisha.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near Govt. Women's College, Balangir, Odisha

description: The OD-04 Regional Transport Office serves the Chandikhole region within the Jajpur district of Odisha. It is a strategically significant office located at the intersection of major national highways, handling heavy commercial vehicle traffic and local registrations.
address: Regional Transport Office, Chandikhole, Dist: Jajpur, Odisha

description: The OD-05 RTO is the primary transport authority for Cuttack, the former capital and second-largest city of Odisha. It oversees vehicle registration, licensing, and road safety regulations for the urban and rural areas of the Cuttack district.
address: Near Collectorate, P.O. - Chandni Chowk, P.S. - Lalbag, Cuttack

description: The OD-06 RTO is the primary Regional Transport Office for the Dhenkanal district in Odisha, responsible for vehicle registration, licensing, and road safety enforcement. It transitioned from the legacy prefix OR-06 in 2012 and serves as a major administrative hub for the central industrial and agricultural region of the state.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near College Chowk, Dhenkanal, Odisha

description: The OD-07 RTO is the Regional Transport Office for the Ganjam district in Odisha, located at its administrative headquarters in Chatrapur. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for one of the state's most populous regions, excluding the areas under the Bhanjanagar ARTO jurisdiction.
address: Office of the Regional Transport Officer, Near Collectorate, Chatrapur, Ganjam, Odisha

description: OD-08 is the Regional Transport Office for the Kalahandi district in Odisha, based in Bhawanipatna. It is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations across the district. The office transitioned from the OR-08 prefix to OD-08 in 2012 following the state name change.

The OD-09 RTO office serves the Keonjhar district in Odisha, handling vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits. It is a vital administrative hub for the transport sector in this mineral-rich region, ensuring compliance with the Motor Vehicles Act.

OD-10 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Koraput district in Odisha. It handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and permit issuances for the southern tribal belt of the state, ensuring adherence to the Motor Vehicles Act.
